verification_items.output_tail: 1426:- `context-mode` routes through [context-mode-dispatch.sh](shared/hooks/scripts/context-mode-dispatch.sh) `server` mode, which forwards a public-stdio filter (`shared/hooks/scripts/context-mode-mcp-filter.mjs`) in front of pinned Context Mode `1.0.169`. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and OpenAI Codex route through the same dispatcher. The fourth generated target, Google Antigravity, gets the same server entry in `.agents/mcp_config.json`, but its PreToolUse bridge denies any tool it does not recognize, including every MCP call, so Antigravity cannot use it (see [runtime-checks.md](docs/runtime-checks.md)). The filter advertises and allows exactly four tools — `ctx_index`, `ctx_search`, `ctx_stats`, `ctx_doctor` — and rejects every other tool (`ctx_execute`, `ctx_execute_file`, `ctx_batch_execute`, `ctx_fetch_and_index`, `ctx_upgrade`, `ctx_purge`, `ctx_insight`, and any unknown tool) locally, before the request reaches upstream. Guarded `ctx_index` accepts content, a contained regular file, or a contained real directory. Directory-policy knobs stay fixed at the pinned upstream defaults, so callers do not pass `include`, `exclude`, `maxDepth`, `maxFiles`, `extensions`, `respectGitignore`, or `followSymlinks`.
